Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games

  • Philadelphia Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) did not return to Sunday's win over the Titans. Running back Saquon Barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger. Barkley returned to the field after halftime.
  • Miami Dolphins running back Jaylen Wright (stinger) and defensive end Robert Beal Jr. (hamstring) did not return to Sunday's loss to San Francisco.
  • Green Bay Packers tackle Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) was ruled out of Sunday's win over the Jets.
  • New England Patriots offensive lineman Mike Onwenu (ankle) was ruled out in the first half of Sunday's win over the Steelers.
  • Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price (chest) did not return to Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
  • Las Vegas Raiders player Ted Danger (ankle) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
